stories.title: i18n foundation: lib/i18n.ts utility + locale state + cookie persistence
acceptanceCriteria: lib/i18n.ts exports useLocale() hook returning { locale, setLocale, t }
Default locale is 'ko' when no cookie is present
setLocale('en') writes a cookie 'lang=en' with 1-year expiry; setLocale('ko') writes 'lang=ko'
useLocale() reads the 'lang' cookie on mount and uses it (falling back to 'ko')
t(key) returns the string from the correct dictionary for the current locale; falls back to key when missing
lib/i18n.ts compiles with no TypeScript errors (npx tsc --noEmit clean for this file)
